concerns.text: FR-013 defines `exposure_level` as the proportion of comments the user has viewed from target subreddits, which can only be inferred from the user's own comment stream. This makes the predictor (exposure) and outcome (self‑evaluation) derived from the same Reddit comment data, violating Constitution Principle VI (Distinct Data Stream Integrity) and turning the moderation analysis into a circular test of the same data source.

FR-010 introduces a `curated_aesthetic_score` (visual‑curation cues) that was not part of the original research question, which only required authenticity cues and engagement metrics. Adding this extra feature expands the scope beyond what the idea explicitly demanded.
